name: MockHub
description: Secondary concert ticket marketplace with agentic commerce support. Search events, browse listings, manage cart, purchase tickets, and manage agent mandates via MCP tools.

skills.name: Ticket Search
skills.description: Search for events and available ticket listings by query, category, city, date range, price range, and section
examples: Find concerts in New York under $150

skills.name: Ticket Purchase
skills.description: Complete a ticket purchase workflow: add to cart, checkout, and confirm order. Requires an active mandate.
examples: Buy the cheapest ticket that matches my budget
Add listing 42 to my cart and check out

skills.name: Mandate Management
skills.description: Create, list, validate, and revoke agent mandates that authorize agents to act on behalf of users
examples: Create a purchase mandate with a $200 per-transaction limit

skills.name: Price Analysis
skills.description: Get price history and AI-powered price predictions for events
examples: What's the price trend for the top result in this search?
